name: Dexamethasone
executiveSummary: Potent long-acting corticosteroid. Usual adult 4–20 mg/day IV/PO by indication; pediatric croup **0.6 mg/kg** once (max 16 mg); severe COVID 6 mg/day; antiemetic 4–8 mg.
indications:
## Indications

- Cerebral edema, selected bacterial meningitis high-dose regimens, asthma/exacerbations, croup.
- Nausea prophylaxis (CINV/PONV) and severe COVID-19 requiring O₂ (RECOVERY regimen).
- Fetal lung maturation (obstetric betamethasone/dexamethasone).

## Precautions

- Hyperglycemia, immunosuppression, ulcer, psychosis, hypertension. Do not stop abruptly after prolonged use.
- Approximate equivalence: **0.75 mg dexamethasone ≈ 5 mg prednisone ≈ 4 mg methylprednisolone**.

> Dose is highly indication-dependent.

adulto.dose: General anti-inflammatory: **4–10 mg IV/IM/PO** every 6–12 h (titrate). Cerebral edema: often **10 mg IV** load, then **4 mg every 6 h**. Antiemetic: **4–8 mg IV/PO**. Severe COVID-19: **6 mg PO/IV every 24 h × 10 days** (or until discharge). Shock/high-dose ICU: per institutional regimen.
adulto.administration: Slow IV or diluted; IM; PO. Nebulization only if local protocol allows.
adulto.notes: Monitor glycemia. GI prophylaxis on high/prolonged courses.

pediatrico.dose: Croup: **0.15–0.6 mg/kg PO/IM/IV once** (usual **0.6 mg/kg**; max **10–16 mg**). Anti-inflammatory: **0.08–0.3 mg/kg/day** in 2–4 doses. High dose (edema/selected meningitis): **0.5–2 mg/kg/day** divided. Asthma/exacerbation: often **0.15–0.3 mg/kg** (adult max) per local guide.
pediatrico.administration: Prefer PO in croup if tolerated; IV/IM if not. Dilute for ~15 min infusion if indicated.
pediatrico.notes: A single dose usually suffices in croup. Dose by weight.

neonatal.dose: Lung maturation: **maternal** regimen (e.g. 6 mg IM every 12 h × 4 doses) — not a neonate regimen. In neonates: NNU schemes only (BPD, etc.); avoid prolonged courses for neurodevelopment.
neonatal.administration: Maternal IM / neonatal IV per protocol.

stability:
## Stability

- Opened ampoule: discard remainder.
- IV dilution: per label; use within the shift.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Hyperglycemia, insomnia, hypertension, fluid retention, immunosuppression, myopathy, osteoporosis, adrenal suppression, opportunistic infections.
